items.label: Timeless Vintage Oval Design
items.value: The Women’s Watch features a classic, elegant oval shape with a luxurious gold-tone finish, offering a sophisticated look that complements both casual and formal outfits timeless accessory.

items: Quartz watches： providing precise and accurate time keeping. Oval watches for women with mineral glass protects watch from scratches, stainless steel band and case, providing excellent wearing experience.

items.label: Women's Wrist Watches
items.value: Elegant and Eye-catching. This Wrist Watch is A Nice Gift for Wife, Girlfriend, Mom, Aunt, Sisters. A gifts for her on birthday, wedding , anniversary,thanksgiving, Christmas.

items.label: Water Resistance with Care Instructions
items.value: Rated for 30M water resistance, this watch is suitable for everyday wear However to maintain the watch luster and prevent oxidation, we advise against exposing it to water. Please avoid wearing it during bathing, swimming, or diving.

items.label: Adjustable Band
items.value: The watch is smooth and soft on your wrist, ensuring comfortable wear for long periods of time; comes with a removal tool, allowing you to easily customize the fit for maximum comfort
